note: The input file supplies two-byte chunk lengths that control each virtual reader response consumed by the project fuzzer reader implementation.
The fuzzer-controlled chunk for the protocol-version APDU is fetched; the candidate makes this response contain only status bytes and no response data.
After removing the two status bytes, the virtual reader reports a zero-length response to the caller.
A prior input-controlled status-only response makes applet selection succeed so execution reaches the Muscle protocol-version probe.
The transmit call may return success with apdu.resplen equal to zero; the code should require response length greater than zero before using response bytes.
The first byte of the stack response buffer is read even though no response data was copied into it, causing an uninitialized read.
